title: AS2 compiler: for..in loop not implemented
description: The AS2 compiler in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts may not handle ForIn statements. A for(k in obj) loop should emit: push(obj), ActionEnumerate2 (0x55) — which pushes all keys and a null sentinel — then pop and process. Check the ForIn visitor; if missing, implement it. ActionEnumerate2 pushes property names onto the stack with null at top, so the loop body should pop one key per iteration until null.
